title.zh: Loopscale 在攻击相关冻结后重新开放所有金库
title.en: Loopscale Reopens All Vaults After Attack-Related Freeze

current_state.zh:
Loopscale 已恢复所有金库的运营，包括 USDC Genesis Vault，并在安全攻击后解除了剩余的贷款管理限制。该协议宣布，服务恢复后将进行技术事后分析。

重新开放标志着关键安全事件的解决，并恢复了用户对平台资金和借贷功能的访问。

此次重启特别包括 USDC Genesis Vault，该金库在冻结期间曾受到贷款管理限制。
current_state.en:
Loopscale has resumed operations for all its vaults, including the USDC Genesis Vault, and lifted remaining loan-management restrictions following a security attack. The protocol announced that a technical post-mortem will follow this restoration of service.

The reopening signals the resolution of a critical security incident and restores user access to funds and lending functions on the platform.

The restart specifically includes the USDC Genesis Vault, which had been subject to loan-management restrictions during the freeze.

updates.background_zh: Loopscale 是 Solana 上的一种模块化、基于订单簿的借贷协议，支持超额抵押借贷。USDC Genesis Vault 是该协议内的一种策略，旨在将闲置流动性部署到固定利率借贷市场和可变利率借贷协议中。
updates.background_en: Loopscale is a modular, order book-based lending protocol on Solana that enables overcollateralized borrowing and lending. The USDC Genesis Vault is a strategy within the protocol designed to deploy idle liquidity into fixed-rate borrow markets and variable-rate lend protocols.
updates.market_impact_zh: 运营恢复将恢复 Solana 网络上 USDC 及其他资产的流动性和借贷能力，可能稳定 Loopscale 协议用户的市场情绪。
updates.market_impact_en: The resumption of operations restores liquidity and lending capacity for USDC and other assets on the Solana network, potentially stabilizing sentiment for users of the Loopscale protocol.
